corpus_description: UTF-8 installed macOS manual source text, <=1 MiB/file, >=200 characters. No symlinks or NUL bytes.
model: English sentence model unavailable; keyword search works
reference: SQLite FTS5 BM25 ORDER BY rank
timing_scope: Query string to materialized title/path/page/snippet results. Includes canonicalization or fresh sentence embedding, scoring, top-k and snippets. Excludes initial indexing, reference index preparation, UI drawing, disk cold-start and model loading. No query-result cache. Alternating path order; one warmup per query/path. Keyword engines use identical canonical tokens and BM25; meaning uses ternary shortlist then original FP32 reranking, compared with full FP32 scan. Not a comparison with HNSW, Spotlight or other commercial search products.
